certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — First-time Adoption of IFRS (IFRS 1)

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the objective of the first-time adoption standard and the opening IFRS statement of financial position
Identify the date of transition and the first IFRS reporting period
Apply the general principle of retrospective application of IFRS
Apply the mandatory exceptions to retrospective application
Apply the optional exemptions available on first-time adoption
Prepare the reconciliations required in the first IFRS financial statements

integrative_case: A company reporting under local GAAP is adopting IFRS for the first time and must set its transition date, build an opening IFRS statement of financial position, decide which optional exemptions (such as deemed cost) to use, apply the mandatory exceptions, and prepare the equity and profit reconciliations required in its first IFRS financial statements.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
